title: CutClaw: Agentic Multi-Agent Music-Synchronized Video Editing
summary: CutClaw is an end-to-end multi-agent framework that automates the editing of hours-long video footage into music-synchronized shorts. It employs a pipeline of specialized agents—Playwriter, Editor, and Reviewer—to handle narrative planning and rhythmic alignment.
research_notes: The system utilizes LiteLLM for model orchestration and extracts musical beats and energy signals to ensure edits align with rhythmic shifts.

evolution.summary: Since its release alongside the paper in March 2026, the project has moved toward ecosystem integration. Current roadmap priorities include ARC-Chapter integration for reduced computational costs, a low-cost selective footage reading mode, and future support for Claude Code MCP.
